items.title: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应
items.summary: Philipp Schmid 转引 Sundar Pichai 的消息：Google Project Suncatcher 在数周前发射原型卫星后，成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地面收到了首个完整回应（一首 haiku），作者称 Gemma 4 成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型。
items.title_original: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items.title_en: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items.title_zh: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应
items.title_bilingual: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应 / This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items.recommend_reason_zh: 标题称Gemma 4成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型，但正文仅重复该标题并附"查看最新动态并加入对话"提示，未给出任务名称、硬件或验证细节，读者可据此判断信息量。

en.summary: Philipp Schmid, citing Sundar Pichai: weeks after launching a prototype satellite, Google's Project Suncatcher successfully sent commands to orbit, powered up a TPU, ran a prompt, and received the first full response back on the ground (a haiku). The author says Gemma 4 is now the first large language model to run in space.
en.reason: Google's Project Suncatcher reportedly sent commands to a prototype satellite, booted a TPU in orbit and received a haiku from Gemma 4, which Philipp Schmid calls the first LLM run in space — though the post offers few verification details.

items.title: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox
items.summary: Epoch AI 实验发现，Z.ai 八月发布的开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用 Mozilla 已发布但未推送给用户的安全补丁（patch gap），自主构建网页攻击，仅访问页面即可读取访客电脑文件，攻破 9 月 17 日至 10 月 26 日发布的全部六个 Firefox 版本。
items.title_original: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
items.title_en: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
items.title_zh: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox
items.title_bilingual: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox / AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
items.recommend_reason_zh: 实验显示，Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 仅用约 $1,000 算力，从 Mozilla 已发布未推送的修复中逆向漏洞，最快 12 小时让 Firefox 用户仅访问网页即泄露文件。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.

Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.
en.reason: Andy Jassy says AWS can become a $1 trillion annual-revenue business in five to ten years, while Amazon plans about $220 billion in 2026 cash capex, mostly for AWS, after AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate.

en.title: Andrew Ng, co-founder of Google Brain, says AI has moved entirely beyond prompts into a new phase of loops and graphs.
en.summary:
Andrew Ng, founder of Google Brain, says AI has moved entirely beyond prompts into a new phase of "loops and graphs."

The evolution of AI interaction: Chat → Agents → Loops (self-correcting cycles) → Graphs (graph-structured planning).

1. A single-turn chat gives you a draft.
2. A Loop delivers the finished product.
3. A Graph architecture locks in the optimal workflow before anything runs.

This is the self-improving Agent that can truly drive the cost of productivity down to near zero.
en.reason: Andrew Ng argues AI has shifted from prompts to Loops and Graphs, tracing a Chat→Agents→Loops→Graphs path where single-turn chat gives drafts, Loops deliver finished output, and Graphs lock the optimal workflow before running to push productivity costs toward zero.

en.title: Holy crap — someone finally made a reference answer for the "silky-smooth animation" AI just can't understand.
en.summary:
Holy crap—someone finally made a reference for the silky-smooth animations AI can’t understand!

The most annoying part of making Vibe Coding videos: you’ve got cinematic motion in your head, spend forever describing it to AI, and the result looks like PowerPoint slides.

Recommend this open-source Skill: Motion Prompt.

It turns all kinds of animations, camera moves, transitions, and UI motion into visual examples. See an effect you like, and just throw the prompt and implementation reference at AI.

No more racking your brain to describe it—just have AI build it to match!

For anyone using Claude Code or Codex, especially those who love making animations with Vibe Coding, bookmark this.

Install:
npx skills add showheyohtaki/motion-prompt

items_ai.summary: Philipp Schmid 转引 Sundar Pichai 的消息：Google Project Suncatcher 在数周前发射原型卫星后，成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地面收到了首个完整回应（一首 haiku），作者称 Gemma 4 成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型。
items_ai.title_original: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items_ai.title_en: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?

en.reason: Google's Project Suncatcher reportedly sent commands to a prototype satellite, booted a TPU in orbit and received a haiku from Gemma 4, which Philipp Schmid calls the first LLM run in space — though the post offers few verification details.

items_ai.summary: Epoch AI 实验发现，Z.ai 八月发布的开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用 Mozilla 已发布但未推送给用户的安全补丁（patch gap），自主构建网页攻击，仅访问页面即可读取访客电脑文件，攻破 9 月 17 日至 10 月 26 日发布的全部六个 Firefox 版本。

items_ai.title_en: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update

items_ai.title_bilingual: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox / AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: 实验显示，Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 仅用约 $1,000 算力，从 Mozilla 已发布未推送的修复中逆向漏洞，最快 12 小时让 Firefox 用户仅访问网页即泄露文件。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.

en.title: Andrew Ng, co-founder of Google Brain, says AI has moved entirely beyond prompts into a new phase of loops and graphs.
en.summary:
Andrew Ng, founder of Google Brain, says AI has moved entirely beyond prompts into a new phase of "loops and graphs."

The evolution of AI interaction: Chat → Agents → Loops (self-correcting cycles) → Graphs (graph-structured planning).

1. A single-turn chat gives you a draft.
2. A Loop delivers the finished product.
3. A Graph architecture locks in the optimal workflow before anything runs.

This is the self-improving Agent that can truly drive the cost of productivity down to near zero.
en.reason: Andrew Ng argues AI has shifted from prompts to Loops and Graphs, tracing a Chat→Agents→Loops→Graphs path where single-turn chat gives drafts, Loops deliver finished output, and Graphs lock the optimal workflow before running to push productivity costs toward zero.

en.title: Holy crap — someone finally made a reference answer for the "silky-smooth animation" AI just can't understand.
en.summary:
Holy crap—someone finally made a reference for the silky-smooth animations AI can’t understand!

The most annoying part of making Vibe Coding videos: you’ve got cinematic motion in your head, spend forever describing it to AI, and the result looks like PowerPoint slides.

Recommend this open-source Skill: Motion Prompt.

It turns all kinds of animations, camera moves, transitions, and UI motion into visual examples. See an effect you like, and just throw the prompt and implementation reference at AI.

No more racking your brain to describe it—just have AI build it to match!

For anyone using Claude Code or Codex, especially those who love making animations with Vibe Coding, bookmark this.

Install:
npx skills add showheyohtaki/motion-prompt
